about: Refactor 17, Stage B, decision D1: the Durable Object files and the Portal files of the foundation module collaboration join the workspace package @purin-labs/collaboration in packages/collaboration, which holds the CRDT core of the module in src/. scripts/refactor-17/move-module.mjs reads this plan. files: each source file that scripts/layers.json gives the module, with its place in the target folder: the 4 Actor files in worker/ and the Portal feature folder in portal/, outside the src/ include of the package tsconfig, so that the core in src/ stays free of Worker and React imports and its own type check reads only src/ and tests/. sourcePrefixes: where --sync-plan puts a file that the module gets later. package.existing true: the package exists; its manifest gets the export entries and the dependencies of this plan and keeps its tsconfig, its scripts and its line in scripts/layers.json. The Worker program checks the files of worker/, and the Portal program checks the files of portal/. edits: text edits of the files that name a root folder and cannot read scripts/lib/source-roots.mjs, and of a path that is no import; an edit is done when the file holds its replace text. keepForm: each file where an import stays on its line, because the wrap of Prettier would move a ratchet, with its reason. regenerate: the commands that write a generated file again.

edits.why: the lints of the Worker source and ESLint read the Durable Object files of the package; the line of PLATFORM_SOURCE stays as the kernel plan wrote it
the Portal lints and the ESLint rules of the Portal source read the Portal files of the package; the list stays as the control plan wrote it
